name: What are some cost-effective ways to update an investment property?

mainEntity.name: What are some cost-effective ways to update an investment property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost-effective updates for an investment property often focus on high-impact visual changes that don't require extensive structural work. Painting walls a neutral color, updating light fixtures and hardware, replacing old faucets, and installing new vinyl plank flooring or refreshed landscaping can significantly enhance appeal without breaking the bank. A practical tradeoff is choosing durable, attractive materials that are cost-effective upfront and also inexpensive to maintain or replace between tenants. For properties in areas like West Boise or South Boise Village, focusing on small, impactful changes can draw in tenants efficiently and help manage your budget effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost-effective updates include painting, new light fixtures, hardware, faucets, and durable flooring or refreshed landscaping for high impact.
